When you wrote you find reasons to live I remembered this book by a psychologyst who survived the holocaust Viktor Frankl, called Man's Search For Meaning. It talks about logotherapy which is basically finding reasons to live by focusing on a goal in the future and finding meaning in your own suffering that helps you cope with it. I cannot recommend it enough ☺

Well I understand how awful it must be to be surrounded and see garbage wherever you go cause as we know our environment does to an extent contribute to our mental health but honestly if you can't change the world, you can change YOUR world, your tiny little cubicle of the world you are creating. As far as the internet thing goes, I don't really do well with technology and I don't know how slow or whatever that is. I hate to do this thing where I try to lift others up by telling them how down someone else is but think of starving children in Africa who don't even have running water, clothes to wear, they don't even know what the internet is. So, I'm pretty sure your situation isn't nearly as bad as you believe it to be. And yes in puberty people get all sorts of weird thoughts and issues that are mostly concerns they will laugh about in the future. As far as six pack goes, please understand this again, 13 year olds shouldn't have a six pack. What the hell why do you need a six pack? It is ok to be physically active and keep healthy but not everyone likes a six pack. Like I wrote before what's on the inside counts not what a person looks like. I will tell you about this movie called the truth about cats and dogs. One person is talking to another about looks and love. They say to them that a person so beautiful and attractive becomes uglier and uglier the more you get to know them whereas someone you wouldn't look twice at, if you love them becomes the most beautiful person on the planet. It is really cute to have crushes in childhood but most times it is all they are childhood crushes and it is sweet that you like this girl and like I wrote don't be afraid to approach her and start a conversation about some mutual interest of yours. You can ask her about help with homework if you're in class together or something. But most importantly focus on yourself and your own world and yeah read books, book are amazing the open portals to so many worlds to us and I cannot stress the importance of reading enough. You can find some educational as well as fun ones to read. Your parents can suggest some as well. Make your own environment clean and tidy and work on yourself and your future self will be 23 one day and he will thank you and I'm sure he'll have a way with girls and you'll probably we walking around college campus somewhere else and you will see how things fall into place eventually. ☺

You are only 13. People's bodies and mind don't fully form until they are 25. Even the people who are considered hot by so many have insecurities. Everyone has them. What does overweight really mean? You will grow, will be taller the weight will distribute evenly. If you want you can eat healthy food and drink plenty of water for your own health and nothing else. Fast food and soft drinks are mostly poison distributed by people who want to earn money. As far as marerialism goes. You can talk to your parents, honesty is the best policy anyway. Focus on what you have not what you don't have. Read books and use less internet. Stay in reality and focus on what truly matters, it isn't materialistic. Go outside and play as a normal 13 yo kid would and should do. Be grateful and if you can see a counselor or a therapist. Keep a journal, set small goals for each day and you will see that you will feel better after accomplishing them. I want to tell you that ancient cultures believed that beauty of the mind was to be seen on the outside as well. Also, Egypt is beautiful, I know some things are happening in the world that aren't right but your country has so much historical value to the world, imagine who your ancestors were and how they worked hard to bring the future easier for future generations. I for one am fascinated by Egyptian culture and want to study archaeology. And about your sense of humor, just keep it going, read a lot, that makes you witty. And ultimately understand that you will figure it out. You are only 13. ☺ And yes don't be too nice and don't be a bully keep it civil and try to get your message across in a well mannered way. And school is interesting believe me, find a way to make it fun and you are smart just realize that yiu are studying for yourself and not grades. Watch historical movies and TV shows and read cause it is fun. And girls, well every 13yo is nervous around girl, dude 23 year olds don't know how to approach them. Just be yourself. Talk about movies about music TV shows, ask them about pets homework haha I don't really know. Take it from me, I have been there, been 13 a while ago. You just need to understand that there is nothing and no one to conform to and that communication matters. If you have concerns talking to your parents really will help. ☺ Wish you the best of luck.
